issues.where: the animals across the mid-ground flats and channels
issues.what: the herd of wading, grazing creatures in -a (one large walker, several in the water, a sprawled one at right) is gone; -b has only lumpy boulder-like mounds with no legs or heads, so the scene reads as empty
issues.fix: put back several clearly animal creatures at the same scale, wading in and walking beside the red channels, lit by the same flat overcast light

issues.where: the steaming bubbling pool at left
issues.what: -a has a deep red pool with rising steam, concentric ripples and glossy domes swelling up; in -b it is a flat matte pinkish sheet with only a few faint pits and little steam
issues.fix: deepen it into a glossy wine-red pool with ripple rings, rising bubble domes and thick steam drifting through the stalks

issues.where: the shore and water across the foreground and middle
issues.what: -a is a low macro view of a seething pool: a splash with flying droplets, foam and bubble clusters on the salt rim, insects floating, a wading animal behind; -b has calm water with flat white glints, a glassy fan where the splash should be, no droplets, no bubbles, no insects and no animal
issues.fix: bring back the violent splash with airborne droplets, the clustered foam bubbles on the crust, the floating insects and the animal wading at the back of the pool

issues.what: the -a water is dark, glossy, deep red-brown with reflections; -b water is pale, opaque, chalky pink like painted ground
issues.fix: darken and saturate the water toward deep red-maroon and give it gloss and sky reflection

issues.where: the salt crust and the carcasses at right
issues.what: -a crust is cracked plates with wet red seams and the carcasses are hairy, salt-encrusted bodies with legs; -b crust is clean white polygon tiles and the carcasses are plain white ribcage shells; the whole flat is whiter and flatter in tone
issues.fix: stain the crust seams red and wet, roughen the plate edges, and make the carcasses whole salt-crusted bodies with visible limbs

issues.where: the stalk stands and the foreground rock
issues.what: -a stalks are tall pale trunks topped with shaggy red crowns, standing in clumps; -b has thin grass-like reeds with sparse leaves, and the foreground rock is a puffy pitted lump with smeared texture instead of layered weathered stone with rust streaks
issues.fix: make the stalks taller, thicker-trunked with dense red crowns, and give the rock layered, cracked faces with orange-rust staining

issues.what: -a has a defined ridge line and a hanging rain shaft, with the plain receding in layers of red pools and mounds; -b's far plain is a washed-out white blank and the rain shaft is a smeared vertical streak
issues.fix: keep more red pools and stalk clumps going into the distance and soften the rain shaft into a hanging grey veil under the cloud

issues.where: the stalks at the back of the pool
issues.what: -a stalks are palm-like, with red crowns standing close in a grove on the bank in steam; -b has a fence of thin, evenly spaced grasses with a hill behind, and the steam is nearly gone
issues.fix: turn them into a denser grove of crowned stalks and fill the gap between the pool and the grove with drifting steam

issues.what: -a domes are glossy and translucent with highlights and ripples ringing them; -b domes are opaque blotchy plastic shells on a flat, uniform, saturated red sheet
issues.fix: make the domes thin, translucent and wet with reflections, and break up the water with wave texture, foam and colour variation

issues.what: -a has a wet, frothy salt rim with bubbles; -b has a dry heap of brown mud with a smeared white crust
issues.fix: make the near bank a wet foamy salt rim lapped by the pool

issues.where: the insects round the crown and in the air
issues.what: -a has a swarm of large lit winged insects all through and around the near crown; -b has only a few faint specks in the sky
issues.fix: put the swarm back, flying through and settled on the crown, in focus and at the same size

issues.what: -a is thick steam over a red pool, with a salt mound and a wading animal on the right; -b has clear air, a field of thin grasses, a grey boulder where the animal stood, and smooth domes in the pool
issues.fix: fill the background with drifting steam, put the animal back in the water on the right, and set the salt mound behind it

issues.what: -a fronds are fine, branched and frayed with small clear drops; -b fronds are smooth ribbons beaded with large opaque white pearls
issues.fix: break the fronds into finer frayed filaments and make the drops small, clear and refractive

issues.where: the water and the near ground
issues.what: -b water is a flat, matte, mottled red without ripples, and the cobbled salt-strewn ground in the -a foreground is missing
issues.fix: add soft ripples and reflection to the pool and lay salt-crusted pebbles along the near edge
